authority.reason: The choice moves the read-only trust boundary in docs/architecture/coaching-interaction.md, which the repository owner defined and only the owner can relax.

choices.summary: Ship grilling as a consumer-owned skill that writes a candidate evidence file; AEC sees the output only as ordinary submitted evidence.

tradeoffs.maintainability: One more copied artifact per consumer, alongside the existing copied state producer.
tradeoffs.quality: Keeps AEC's evaluator independent of the producer, so a gate pass still means something.
tradeoffs.reversibility: Fully reversible: deleting the skill removes no AEC behaviour and changes no hash.
tradeoffs.risk: Every consumer must install and maintain its own copy, repeating the State construction gap already recorded in the gap map.
tradeoffs.scope: No change to aec/, no change to card_hash, no change to the nine-phase catalog.

choices.summary: Ship grilling inside aec/ as a coach subcommand that interviews the engineer and emits validated evidence.

tradeoffs.maintainability: Introduces nondeterministic model output into a repository whose core promise is a deterministic hash.
tradeoffs.quality: AEC would author the outcome-statement and then judge whether the outcome-statement satisfies intake-outcome, so the gate could no longer fail for a real reason.
tradeoffs.reversibility: Hard to reverse once consumers depend on AEC to produce their evidence.
tradeoffs.risk: Breaks the read-only mentor boundary the consumer profile pins as aec_mode=read-only-mentor.
tradeoffs.scope: Requires new schema, new hash contract, and a second interaction model beside the prompt hook.

choices.summary: Add no procedure. Extend the existing recognition_heuristic text at Intake, Framing, and Spec to name interrogation as the technique, and leave production to the engineer.

tradeoffs.maintainability: Lowest ongoing cost; no new artifact to keep in sync.
tradeoffs.quality: Teaches the judgment without asserting a mechanism that has not been shown to work.
tradeoffs.reversibility: Reversible, but edits hashed card copy and so recomputes card_hash as an ordinary content revision.
tradeoffs.risk: The eight elicited evidence items still have no producer, so the Intake-to-Spec gates stay hard to pass.
tradeoffs.scope: Touches config/procedures/ticket-to-pr.json only, and collides with the pending rewrite in issue #89.

question: Where should a grilling elicitation procedure live so that it can produce Intake, Framing, and Spec evidence without AEC becoming the producer of the evidence it evaluates?

expected_result.threshold: One real task passes Intake, Framing, and Spec using evidence produced by a grilling session.

recommendation.falsifier: A grilling session is run to a clean validate_decision_context pass and the resulting decision_context is then shown to be hollow, meaning a reader who did not attend the session cannot state what would refute the recommendation.
recommendation.principal_uncertainty: Whether interrogation actually raises the quality of elicited evidence, or only its completeness.
revisit_when: A second consumer repository installs AEC.
The State construction gap ships one shared command.
recommendation.why: It is the only option that adds a producer without letting the producer grade its own output.
